messages:
olivia: Heads up — after the KMS rekey earlier today we started seeing 'ghost' RBAC roles show up for a handful of tenants and SCIM deprovisioning lagged. Not sure if this is a SCIM, SAML assertion, or KMS decrypt fallout. Examples below.

olivia: repro timeline: 09:12 rekey completed, 09:14 prod deploy, 09:18 first alert from monitoring (scim-queue-depth), 09:21 first user report of stale role access.

olivia: scim-provisioner log excerpt:
```
2026-03-23T09:20:11Z scim-provisioner INFO tenant=acme op=deprovision user=alice status=queued
2026-03-23T09:20:12Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=acme op=decrypt-kms err=AccessDenied
2026-03-23T09:20:12Z scim-provisioner WARN tenant=acme op=apply-role role=eng-beta duplicated=true
2026-03-23T09:20:15Z scim-provisioner INFO tenant=acme op=retry next=09:22:15
```

olivia: SAML assertion snippet (masked):
```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="roles">eng-beta;eng-beta</saml:Attribute>
<saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">alice@acme.com</saml:NameID>
```

raj: hmmm. did we change anything that touches attribute mapping or the claim splitter? :thinking:

marta: @olivia can you paste the audit log entries for the RBAC change and the KMS rekey? curious if role-doubleapply comes from retry logic after a transient decrypt failure.

olivia: audit snippets:
```
2026-03-23T09:12:00Z audit SERVICE=kms action=rekey user=infra-batch id=kms-rekey-2026-03-23
2026-03-23T09:15:02Z audit SERVICE=rbac action=update user=platform-admin change=role-schema-v2
```

olivia: also saw intermittent 403s from KMS SDK on one AZ only for ~30s. Devops said hardware key rotation finished but there was a momentary permissions hiccup.

security-oncall: flagging potential vuln surface — if decrypt fails and we reapply roles without idempotency checks that could allow stale/duplicated role assignments. Need post-incident audit AND fix in reconciler logic.

raj: agree. quick checks: 1) are SCIM operations idempotent by extId? 2) does the provisioner dedupe roles before persisting? 3) are we storing assertions raw or normalized?

marta: answers: 1) SCIM side is idempotent by externalId but our role-apply path uses a separate 'applyRole' RPC that historically relied on kafka replay protection only. 2) dedupe is best-effort in memory, not enforced in DB. 3) assertions get normalized in the assertion service — but the normalizer was updated in the same deploy as the new role schema (ops timing bad).

olivia: so plausible chain: KMS AccessDenied -> retry path triggers duplicate applyRole -> normalizer changes cause role string to be written twice in different code paths -> DB ends up with duplicated role rows and reconcilers see both and don't de-dupe when deprovisioning -> users keep access.

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T09:14 by infra-cd succeeded (sha:abc123), note: rollback window open until 09:44.

marta: mitigation steps I propose now: 1) pause replays and provisioning retries for affected tenants, 2) run a DB dedupe script that collapses duplicate (tenant, user, role) triples, 3) patch applyRole to be upsert-based and add a unique constraint, 4) tighten KMS error handling to surface AccessDenied immediately. Who can own the DB script?

raj: I can own the DB script, will run in dry-run mode and post results. Also will add temporary reconciliation job to prune duplicates for the next 2h.

security-oncall: I'll open an incident ticket with severity P2 and add required post-mortem checklist: audit export, tenant notification plan for any role-exposure, and timeline reconstruction.

olivia: thanks. raj — ping me when dry-run done. marta — can you prioritize the DB unique constraint as a low-latency patch? also add an automated test for KMS AccessDenied behavior in CI.

marta: will do. quick note: check for JWE header alg drift in assertion service — we saw evidence of header rename in other tenants earlier, which can cause normalizer mismatch. I'll grep logs.

olivia: good call. adding: grep pattern = 'Unexpected Attribute format' across assertion-service logs 09:10-09:25.

raj: dry-run results posted in #eng-sre, approx 42 duplicates across 7 tenants. prepping DB migration and will schedule 1-min maintenance window if safe.

olivia: ok — thanks all. keep this thread for updates only, will cut incident summary when we have timeline. :white_check_mark:
